title: Transactional Lifecycle Audit: Software for Lifecycle-aware Metamorphic Testing
description:
Version 6.0.0 adds the sanitized R3 SQLite lifecycle study to the immutable parent evidence. It contains the preregistered diagnostic and guarded-containment cases, a separately reported historical SQLite WAL/savepoint differential, conditional depth-8 finite-state corroboration, and retained process records.

The six constructed integration faults are author-created tests, not SQLite defects. The bounded model is corroboration, not an unbounded proof. Downloaded SQLite binaries, temporary databases, caches, pilot outputs, private Abaqus/UEL assets, and confidential engineering data are excluded.
